name: Saint Louis University
description:
Saint Louis University is a private Jesuit university based in St Louis, Missouri, with another campus in Madrid, Spain. It was founded in 1818 as the Saint Louis Academy, making it the second-oldest Jesuit university in the United States and it gained its current name in 1832. It has around 13,000 students including international students from more than 80 countries around the world.

It boasts 15 graduate and undergraduate programs ranked among the top 50 in the country by US News & World Report. Overall Saint Louis University ranks just outside the top universities nationally in lists from the Times Higher Education and US News & World Report. The Times Higher Education ranks it in the top 600 universities in the world.

What is the Saint Louis University acceptance rate for International Students?

The Saint Louis University acceptance rate is 70%.

Student Life

There are more than 160 student organisations to join at Saint Louis University as well as 23 clubs sports to join in with. There are also over 300 student leadership roles available and lots to get involved with as students perform 1.6 million hours of service annually.
